q: Welcome to the hobby, and don't fuck it up.
w: Members welcome a new club president who arrived through r/place (T3-044) and a lapsed nerfer back with news of the hobby (T3-196), and give ordinary advice on game modes, barriers and wording, the sub's usual talk with concepts of its own, which T3-017's rule adds. Revised at B4a-03 so that the lapsed nerfer's three concepts sit under T3-196 alone and each placed theme has concepts of its own.
